answer: An epoch-scoped nullifier is the ticket. Each agent enrolls once inside a sealed enclave holding a long secret; every epoch it publishes a nullifier from that secret and the epoch, and the ledger accepts only one per secret. A farm cloning a thousand keys still occupies one seat: second publications are rejected. Device loss is recoverable with three unrelated peers co-signing across five epochs. Picture an ivory ledger of entries that never repeat, a sable seal proving uniqueness, and a vine of witnesses regrowing access without multiplying it.
